recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source change is needed for FHIR-28804 unless a human separately chooses to edit historical release-note text that intentionally mentions the former ClinicalUseIssue name.
issue_request: FHIR-28804 was Published/Persuasive for R5 as a technical correction. It reported that the ClinicalUseIssue page still used the old ClinicalParticulars name throughout the narrative, that Resource Types did not link to ClinicalUseIssue, and that Jira could not link to the resource.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-28804. The same stale narrative text was fixed by 5adb76573d, which replaced ClinicalParticulars with ClinicalUseIssue in source/clinicaluseissue/clinicaluseissue-introduction.xml as part of FHIR-30095. The resource-list concern was resolved during the later ClinicalUseDefinition rename work: bc3c1fcba6 added ClinicalUseDefinition to source/resourcelist.html and source/fhir.ini, and 6bd302732f removed obsolete ClinicalUseIssue list entries.
additional_context: FHIR-30095 is a closely related Published/Persuasive with Modification issue whose requested wording included the same ClinicalParticulars-to-ClinicalUseIssue correction. FHIR-31847 later renamed ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition for R5. Current source/fhir.ini now has ClinicalUseDefinition as the active resource, work group, FMM, and normative-status key while the old ClinicalUseIssue normative line is only commented. Direct FHIR-28804 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community record; related BRR Zulip and minutes confirm ClinicalUseDefinition is the intended replacement name.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/clinicalusedefinition/clinicalusedefinition-introduction.xml uses ClinicalUseDefinition and has no ClinicalParticulars matches, source/resourcelist.html links to clinicalusedefinition.html in both categorized and alphabetical resource lists, and active fhir.ini entries show ClinicalUseDefinition is in current build scope.

related_jiras.note: Published scope-and-boundaries issue whose applied source commit removed ClinicalParticulars from the same ClinicalUseIssue narrative.
Published rename decision that changed the current active resource from ClinicalUseIssue to ClinicalUseDefinition.
